boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time together at the Presidio and nearby USF.

cards.title: Walk the lawns and overlook paths
cards.subtitle: Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Meet at the visitor center, wander the public lawns and paths, then pause at a bench or overlook. No ticket or reservation is needed.
cards.short_summary: A free, open-air meet-up with paths, lawns, and Golden Gate views.
cards.evidence_claim: Presidio Tunnel Tops is free and open to all; no tickets or reservations are required.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; the official page states it is free, open to all, and requires no tickets or reservations.

cards.title: Try a hands-on park activity
cards.subtitle: Presidio Tunnel Tops, San Francisco
cards.notes: Drop into the Field Station during its public hours and use its hands-on activities as a low-key group starting point before exploring Tunnel Tops.
cards.short_summary: A free, public activity hub inside Presidio Tunnel Tops.
cards.evidence_claim: The Field Station is free, open to the public during listed hours, and needs no tickets or reservations.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday–Friday 11 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify before departing.

cards.title: Browse maps and interactive exhibits
cards.subtitle: Main Post, Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Use the visitor center as a meet-up point, look through the interactive exhibits, and pick a shared walking route with a ranger or park map.
cards.short_summary: A daytime indoor stop for maps, exhibits, and route planning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Presidio Visitor Center has interactive exhibits and is located in the Presidio, which has no entrance fee and is open to all.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; walking in is free, while nearby parking is paid.

cards.title: See the Heritage Gallery exhibitions
cards.subtitle: Main Post, Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Plan a daytime gallery visit, compare one exhibition detail that stands out, then continue the conversation outside on the Main Post.
cards.short_summary: Free Presidio-history exhibitions in a historic building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Presidio Officers' Club offers free Heritage Gallery exhibitions; they are open Friday through Sunday and require no ticket.
cards.access_notes: Free exhibitions are open Friday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; no ticket is required.

cards.title: Take a beach walk together
cards.subtitle: Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Bring water and layers, follow the beach at your own pace, and use the public setting for a simple walk-and-talk with friends.
cards.short_summary: A free Presidio beach for a daylight walk by the water.
cards.evidence_claim: Presidio beaches, including Baker Beach, are free to visit.
cards.access_notes: Free to visit; stay on established public beach areas and check weather and ocean conditions.

cards.title: Settle in for waterfront people-watching
cards.subtitle: Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Choose a public spot along the beach, bring something to talk about, and take in the waterfront without needing a reservation or purchase.
cards.short_summary: A free waterfront hang in the Presidio with nearby public paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Crissy Field East Beach is a Presidio beach, and Presidio beaches are free to visit.
cards.access_notes: Free to visit; paid parking may be available nearby, so arrive by transit, bike, or on foot to keep the outing free.

cards.title: Bring binoculars for a wildlife pause
cards.subtitle: Southern Wilds, Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Circle the lake on the paved portion of the trail and look for birds, turtles, or frogs. Keep a respectful distance from the restored habitat.
cards.short_summary: A free nature hang with a lake loop, benches, and wildlife viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: Mountain Lake is described by the Presidio Trust as a free family activity with a lakeside picnic area, trail, and wildlife viewing.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public area with restrooms, picnic tables, and a paved portion of the lake trail.

cards.title: Compare the view from the plaza
cards.subtitle: Arguello Boulevard, Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Meet at the overlook, identify landmarks across the bay, then continue onto the nearby Ecology Trail only if everyone is prepared for the walk.
cards.short_summary: A free Presidio overlook linked to the Ecology Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Inspiration Point Overlook is a Presidio scenic overlook with public-transit and shuttle access; the Presidio has no entrance fee and is open to all.
cards.access_notes: The overlook itself is free to enter; limited nearby parking is paid, so use the shuttle or transit to keep costs at zero.

cards.title: Walk the trail to Baker Beach
cards.subtitle: Southern Wilds to Baker Beach, Presidio, San Francisco
cards.notes: Start at a trailhead, agree on a turnaround point, and use the marked route for a group walk through lake, forest, and coastal scenery.
cards.short_summary: A marked 2.6-mile Presidio route connecting Mountain Lake and Baker Beach.
cards.evidence_claim: Mountain Lake Trail is a 2.6-mile Presidio trail connecting Mountain Lake and Baker Beach; the Presidio has no entrance fee and is open to all.
cards.access_notes: Listed as easy, with paved, gravel, and boardwalk sections; use marked paths and account for the estimated 60-minute walk.

cards.entity_name: Presidio GO Shuttle South Hills Route
cards.title: Ride the free park shuttle
cards.subtitle: Presidio Transit Center and South Hills destinations
cards.notes: Board at Presidio Transit Center and use the route to link a few park stops, such as Mountain Lake, Baker Beach, or Inspiration Point.
cards.short_summary: A no-fare shuttle route for moving between Presidio destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Presidio GO Shuttle South Hills Route is free, available to all, and never requires a shuttle pass.
cards.source_title: Presidio GO Shuttle South Hills Route Schedule
cards.access_notes: Runs daily; official listed service is 6:30 a.m.–7 p.m. weekdays and 11 a.m.–6 p.m. weekends. Check the live schedule before leaving.
